key_evidence_spans: A 66-year-old man presented with a 24-hour history of incomplete closure of the right eye, flattening of the right nasolabial fold, and right-sided hemiplegia
Hemorrhage in the left thalamus-radiation crown region and in the lateral ventricle at 24 hours postonset
Muscle strength in the right upper and lower extremities: grade 0/5
Hypoesthesia noted on the right side
Emergency CT scan of the head
Cerebral MRI with susceptibility-weighted imaging (1 week and 1 month after onset)
